what: D13 universe: the 20 D12 series. path/sha256 = the D12 kline grid (ratio arm), gridPath/gridSha256 = the D13 III grid (1 h TWAP path of Binance 1 m closes, d13_twap). tailCloses = the 1 m closes from STORE_START to GRID_END in the development files (splice check of the live store). climatology = development frequency of target (b) per cell unit. v0 = plug-in prior variance per unit and side (development days, p rescaled to pooled R = 1). ratioSums = kline (fH) and (b) sums of the ratio arm.
